scope: MVP-3 acceptance skeleton for real/fallback/degraded adapter integration behind existing adapter boundaries, starting with fixture and replay safety before provider execution.

fixture_checks.purpose: empty MVP-3 replay safety skeleton with no provider execution
fallback/degraded adapter replay with recorded real/fallback/degraded outcomes

scenarios.assertion: MVP-3 Slice 0 fixtures are deterministic, GitHub-safe, synthetic/redacted/minimal, and contain no provider execution.
Slice 1 profile contract is acceptance-closed by a recorded capability snapshot with provider-agnostic adapter ids/types, explicit real/fallback/degraded output modes, and no provider probe.
Slice 2 adapter harness coverage replays canonical retry/failure/validation/degraded events from recorded journal events only.
Slice 3 runtime assembly coverage replays SESSION_STARTED and ADAPTER_CAPABILITY_SNAPSHOT_RECORDED without provider probes.
Slice 4 ASR contract coverage replays explicit real output mode and safe transcript refs.
Slice 5 Thinker contract coverage replays normalized fallback SemanticFrame refs before downstream Router use.
Slice 6 Slow LLM contract coverage replays validation failure, fallback output labels, and old-plan non-adoption.
Slice 7 TTS contract coverage replays safe normalized audio refs and explicit truncate degradation.
Slice 8 replay distinguishes real/fallback/degraded adapter outcomes, canonical retry/failure/validation/degraded paths, and old-plan adapter output without provider rerun.
Slice 9 acceptance rejects unsafe fixtures, direct provider calls, missing output labels, weakened replay properties, and scope broadening.
